# GTK 4's introspection data decides only what a program's `gir:Gtk-4.0`
# import declares: the platform's own widgets are committed (widgets.sngl).
# `--opt gir=<missing>` reproduces a machine with no GTK 4 introspection data
# regardless of what is installed here.

# Compiling for html is completely unaffected: no gtk4 diagnostics.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --opt gir=/nonexistent/Gtk-4.0.gir --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html
! stderr 'gtk4'

# Nor is a gtk4 program that imports no gir: package.
sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt gir=/nonexistent/Gtk-4.0.gir --out=g app.sngl
exists g/main.go

# One that does names the missing file and how to supply it.
! sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --opt gir=/nonexistent/Gtk-4.0.gir --out=g2 gir.sngl
stderr 'import "gir:Gtk-4.0"'
stderr '--opt gir=/nonexistent/Gtk-4.0.gir'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

window {
    main
}
-- gir.sngl --
import gtk "gir:Gtk-4.0"
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window {
    gtk.GtkLabel(label="hi") {}
}
